name: Nightingale Nightmare
location: Ashton Park School, Blackmoors Lane, Bower Ashton, Bristol BS3 2JL

schedule.what: Registration opens at HQ. Collect your number.
Tea, coffee, hot chocolate and cake back at HQ, with a donation tin out for a local charity. Prizegiving at HQ once the last finisher is in.

prizes.detail: Three prizes, and the category with the most effort in it.
1st Vet 40, Vet 50 and Vet 60 — female and male.
A runner-voted award for the best marshalling station.

finisherPrize: A medal for every finisher, and that means every finisher.

spectating.viewpoint: The top of Nightingale Valley, through the gate on North Road

privacy.registeredOffice: 1 Hengrove Farm, Hengrove Farm Lane, Bristol BS14 9DD
